American Eagle 319005 Heavy Duty Door Saver Arm for American Eagle 3100 door closers

text.description_html:
PDQ Heavy Duty Door Saver Arm

Fits PDQ American Eagle 3100 and American Eagle 3101 Door Closers.

Parallel Arm Mount Only. Door closer must be mounted on the push side of the door.

Also available Heavy Duty Door Saver Hold Open Arm.

Heavy duty rigid arm assembly and soffit plate with field reversible dead stop. Normally used on outswing doors that are subjected to wind. The built in closer arm dead stop protects the closer, door and frame from damage when the door is swung open by the wind. Non-handed for use on right or left hand doors.

Available in Aluminum or Dark Bronze finish.
